title: Azure Data Factory pipeline mental model
summary: Separate connectivity, data shape and orchestration when reasoning about ADF.

blocks.text: Separate connectivity, data shape and orchestration when reasoning about ADF.

items: Datasets describe data structure/location metadata used by activities.
Activities perform movement, transformation or control flow.
Pipelines compose activities; triggers decide when a pipeline starts.

blocks.question: Where should a secret normally live instead of being hardcoded in a pipeline JSON?
blocks.answer: Use managed identity where possible or reference a secret manager such as Azure Key Vault; do not commit credentials into pipeline definitions.

provenance: Original AtlasNote V3 foundation seed authored for product integration; no third-party text or private data.
